correctness.rationale: For k=2^j with j>=1 and both cut sizes a,b>=k−1, computational basis phase is (−1)^{binom(w,k)}=(−1)^{bit_j(w)} by Lucas. Local block bit phases are removed, and the carry sign F_rs=1−2·1_{r+s>=k} yields exact k×k residue coefficient matrix K_rs=2^{−(a+b)/2}sqrt(N_a(r)N_b(s))F_rs. Distinct row differences imply det F=±2^{k−1}; all residue weights positive, so Schmidt rank k exactly. As a,b grow independently at fixed k, residues equidistribute and K→F/k. Then FF^T has entries k−2|r−s|; the antiperiodic discrete Laplacian L satisfies L(FF^T)=4I, eigenmodes give λ_h=[k²sin²((2h−1)π/(2k))]^{-1}, purity 1/3+2/(3k²). Finally pairing odd endpoint frequencies and dominated convergence using q^{-2}(1+log q) yields the iterated Shannon entropy log₂(π²/4)−2/3−12ζʹ(2)/(π²ln2)=2.2808853887532333… bits. k=2 boundary is handled by seam cancellation. Independent direct computational-basis SVD versus K gave discrepancies at most 1.89e−15 in six cases k=2,4,8; independent high-precision odd-series entropy matched the displayed constant. No simultaneous growing-(k,a,b) assertion.
